summary: The phaser shell is one React tree (App.tsx, 627 lines) holding a `View` union `'title'|'combat'|'overworld'|'town'|'dungeon'|'camp'` in useState with no router; every screen is React DOM except the combat board, which is a single Phaser scene (`game/scenes/BoardScene.ts`, 1240 lines) created once at boot into a permanently-mounted, visibility-toggled `#game-canvas-container` and covered by a `pointer-events:none` React `CombatHud` overlay. Everything is authored at a fixed 1280x720 stage that `ui/GameStage.tsx` CSS-transform-scales into a letterbox, so `position:fixed` resolves against the stage and every react-aria overlay must portal into `#game-stage`. Player flow: Title -> New Game (80g, 5 food, starter party) -> first-ever run gets a 5x5 tutorial battle -> overworld + prologue dialogue -> click a node to auto-path (700ms per hop, 1 food per hop, encounter roll per hop that can suspend travel into a DialogueModal, CheckEventModal or a seeded group battle) -> on arrival at town/camp/dungeon/exit an M&B quick-action menu -> Town (Inn/Shop/Tavern ledger spread) | Camp (Rest 20%/1 food) | Dungeon (StS row graph; combat rooms return to the dungeon) | Exit node -> Iron Throne boss -> BattleEndModal (Victory / Defeat / Run Complete / Game Over) -> Continue (consumes pending hop, returns to overworld or dungeon) or New Run / Return to Title. Root-mounted global surfaces: PauseMenu (Esc, top-right button), Save/Load (3 localStorage slots), QuestLog (Q), PartyLoadoutModal (I), DialogueModal (driven by runStore.pendingDialogue), CheckEventModal (local state in three callers), QuitModal, and a backtick-toggled DevHud. The combat HUD anatomy is: herald plaque TopBar (turn, sigil, name, HP meter, AP pips), top-left InitiativeStrip (selector-derived, 8 visible), ModeLabel instruction strip, PhaseBanner on team flip, top-right ForecastPanel (pin-then-confirm, same damage fn as the reducer), bottom-center CardHand (5 cards, click-to-select or StS drag-to-play), bottom-right Move/End Turn, bottom-left Tab danger-zone chip and capture buttons, click-pinned UnitDetailPanel, and a state-derived TutorialOverlay. The strongest asset is the Field Ledger token system in `src/index.css` (two ground scopes that re-declare the text/HP ramp so components invert automatically, three type voices, leather=act / canvas=read, fixed motion tokens, all loops collapsed under reduced-motion) and should be ported verbatim; `game/boardPalette.ts` exists only because Phaser cannot read CSS vars. The two-render-layer split produced most of the debt: a shared geometry module so DOM drag and canvas picking agree, a numeric palette mirror, a `combatUiStore` side channel from Phaser to React, a synthesized Tab KeyboardEvent so a React chip can flip Phaser-owned state, an Esc `defaultPrevented` handshake, `walkingUnits` race guards because store subscriptions render synchronously inside dispatch, a canvas-detach P0, a StrictMode-killed BootScene, `game.scale.refresh()` after every rescale, and the enemy AI turn loop living inside the render layer; a single-layer rebuild (DOM/SVG board or one canvas owning HUD too) removes all of it. Dev conveniences worth keeping: `?view=combat|overworld|town|dungeon|camp` (DEV-only run seeding that skips tutorial+prologue), `window.__debug` (three stores, busRefs, diag ring buffer), `window.__game`, `window.__openCheckEvent`, and the locked 1280x720 Electron shell (`electron/main.cjs`) that loads Vite on the pinned :5183 port.

requirements.text: Top-level navigation is a single `View` state ('title'|'combat'|'overworld'|'town'|'dungeon'|'camp') with no router; screens receive callbacks (onTravelToCombat, onEnterTown(nodeId, panel?), onEnterCamp, onEnterDungeon, onWin, onLeave, onClearAndExit, onCombatRoom(roomType)) and the shell flips the view. Non-title views show a PauseButton top-right (z-120).

New Game: metaStore startNewRun; run gets addGold 80 and applyQuestEffects [{kind:'addFood',amount:5}]; starter party from buildStarterParty() is recruited only if partyOrder is empty; if !metaStore.tutorialSeen seed seedTutorialBattle with deriveRng(createRng(run.rngState),'battle:tutorial'), markTutorialSeen, view='combat'; else view='overworld' and if !flags.has('prologue_seen') dispatch startDialogue {dialogueId:'prologue', nodeId:'start'}.
Tutorial->overworld handoff: onContinueToOverworld detects battleTag==='tutorial' and, if prologue not yet seen, starts the prologue dialogue after landing on the overworld.

Battle-end sync must fire ONCE per phase transition (track lastPhase; an every-change subscription re-dispatched fallenUnit on every update). On VICTORY/DEFEAT: dispatch fallenUnit {unitId, cause:'battle', turn} per dead party unit. On VICTORY additionally: sweepFallenUnits, battleId=`${worldPosition.nodeId}:d${daysElapsed}`, resolveBattle({state, battleId, partyIds, enemyIds, consumedTravelHop:null, lootRng: deriveRng(createRng(run.rngState), `loot:${battleId}`), lootPool: allItemDefs()}), applyBattleResult, eventBus.replayAll(result.emittedEvents), resolveCaptureTargets(run.pendingCaptureTargets, {capturedIds, survivingEnemyIds}) -> applyQuestEffects then setPendingCaptureTargets [], battleTag==='finalBoss' -> metaStore recordRunCompleted {won:true}, sfx('victory'). On DEFEAT: recordRunCompleted {won:false}, sfx('defeat').

Continue after victory: if pendingTravelPath.remainingNodeIds non-empty, arriveAtNode(next) and startTravelPath with remainingNodeIds []; reset combatStore; return to 'dungeon' when run.activeDungeon !== null && battleTag !== 'finalBoss', else 'overworld' (dungeon boss room clears activeDungeon before this runs).

Battle seeding routes: travel encounter -> seedGroupBattle(enemyGroupId, enemyLevelFor(mapId, `${mapId}:${nodeId}:${daysElapsed}`), deriveRng(run rng, `battle:${groupId}:${nodeId}`).state(), livingParty); dungeon room -> seedDungeonBattle(dungeonId ?? 'smugglers_cave', roomType, deriveRng(`battle:${dungeonId}:${roomType}`), livingParty); exit node -> seedBossBattle(deriveRng('battle:finalBoss'), livingParty) with battleTag 'finalBoss'; combat phase BOOT (dev ?view=combat) -> BoardScene.create seeds seedStubBattle(run.rngState, recruitedParty). Seeder throws are caught, diag-logged and the view still flips to combat (silent stub fallback) — the rebuild must fail loudly instead.

livingParty = party.partyOrder mapped to units, filtered hp.current > 0; every seeder places at most 6 party units into PARTY_SLOTS [[2,4],[2,5],[1,4],[1,5],[0,4],[0,5]] and resets ap:3, armor:0, statuses:[] and team:'party'; decks are built per unit with buildDeckForUnit (innate + hand-slot gear cards).

Save: buildSaveFile({meta:{gameStarted,totalRuns}, run: full runStore state, combat: combat state only when phase==='COMBAT' else null, actionLog: actionLog.serialize()}) -> writeSlot(slotId, save, `Slot ${n+1}`); closes save modal and pause menu. Load: readSlot -> if ok dispatch hydrateFromSave {gold, worldPosition, partyUnits, partyOrder, inventoryItems, flags, questStates, rngState, daysElapsed, runStats, oneShotsFired, visitedNodes, clearedEncounters, deathLog} -> combatStore.reset() -> view 'overworld'. Bad save closes silently (no toast).

Global keys: Q toggles QuestLog and I toggles Loadout only in overworld/town/dungeon/camp; Esc first closes an open modal (save -> load -> questlog -> loadout), in combat is ignored when subPhase !== 'IDLE' (BoardScene cancels selection and calls preventDefault; App checks e.defaultPrevented), otherwise toggles PauseMenu; never on title. Backtick toggles DevHud (dev). Tab toggles danger zone; right-click cancels selection; left-click during a walk animation skips it.

Audio: unlockAudio on first pointerdown/keydown; setMusicContext by view (combat->'combat', town->'town', overworld|camp|dungeon->'overworld', title->'none'); setMuted follows metaStore.audioMuted; ambient music is currently disabled by MUSIC_ENABLED=false (SFX stay: victory, defeat, heal, hitMagic, hitPhysical).

Quit: try window.close(); if the tab survives show QuitModal ('Thanks for playing' / 'You can close this tab now.' / Back to title). Return to Title (pause or battle end) resets combatStore then setView('title'). Battle Restart currently resets combat and flips title->combat after a 50ms setTimeout to force the scene to reseed — replace with an explicit reseed.

Fixed 1280x720 design stage (STAGE_W/STAGE_H in ui/stage.ts) inside a full-viewport letterbox (#17110c) scaled by transform: scale(min(innerWidth/1280, innerHeight/720)), transformOrigin center; screens fill with h-full w-full (never h-screen); use STAGE_W/STAGE_H for layout math; react-aria Modal/Popover/Tooltip MUST portal into #game-stage via stagePortalContainer() or they render unscaled at document.body; after each rescale call window.__game.scale.refresh() in a rAF so canvas picking stays aligned.

requirements.text: If Phaser is retained: createGame(parent) with width 1280, height 720, transparent:true (DOM backdrop shows through), pixelArt:true, disableContextMenu, single scene BoardScene keyed 'combat' (BootScene removed — delayedCall scene.start broke under React StrictMode double-mount); main.tsx mounts Phaser in a rAF loop only after #game-canvas-container exists; the container must stay mounted for the app lifetime and be visibility-toggled, never unmounted (unmounting destroyed the canvas and every later battle drew into a detached canvas).

Game-surface discipline: html/body user-select none, cursor default, overscroll-behavior none, touch-action manipulation; inputs/textarea opt back in; img/canvas/svg -webkit-user-drag none; scrollbars thin leather (rgba(106,75,47,0.55) thumb, 8px).

Title = reference PAGE: oak-table gradient (168deg #3f2e1d->#2e2115->#241a10) with plank lines, an 820px linen sheet (top/bottom inset 26, gradient #f3ecda->canvas-base->canvas-mid->canvas-deep), linen weave (iron-grain multiply 0.5), 35px ruling masked 16%-84%, double margin rule at 52/56px from sheet edge, four brass pins, daylight wash, 6 dust motes (emberRise). Center: title GAME_TITLE 'Embermarch' voice-display 6xl uppercase walnut ink between two flat ink rules with brass corner brackets, tagline 'a tactical roguelite', nav w-72: New Game (primary — the only leather), Load Game (ghost; disabled when no non-empty slot, tooltip 'No chronicle yet — forge a new one.' via a role=button wrapper because disabled buttons emit no pointer events), Quit (ghost); footer 'steel remembers'.

Shipped overworld is the Oregon-Trail split view: TravelBand y 0-264 (decorative, aria-hidden, CSS-keyframe parallax paused via animation-play-state when idle, .is-westward reverses), 12px carved seam, PaperMap y 276-720 (444 tall) panning X only with camera clamp [STAGE_W - map.width, 0] and a 775px center bias, mouse drag with 8px threshold; three authored region JSONs (borderlands/thornwood/ashfall) joined by regionEdges rendered as pressable gateway buttons; GameHud surface='parchment' roster docked `left-4 bottom-6`; bottom status line 'click a node to travel · drag to pan' until first completed hop, 'traveling… N hop(s) left' while moving. NOTE: the owner decided 2026-08 on ONE open-sheet 2-D map (25-40 nodes, hub towns) replacing the three strips — rebuild the map as a 2-D pannable sheet; keep only the travel/encounter rules below.

Click a node = go (no plan/confirm): findPath(buildGraph(map.edges), current, target) -> startTravelPath {remainingNodeIds, totalHopsThisLeg, rngBranch}. A hop driver effect executes the next hop after HOP_DELAY_MS 700 only while no pendingDialogue, no open quick menu, no active check event. executeHop: dispatch consumeFoodPerHop (starvation 3 HP/unit when food is 0); region-edge hop -> enterMap {mapId, nodeId} with no roll; hopRng = deriveRng(parent, `hop:${mapId}:${from}->${to}#${pass}`) where pass = edgeTraversals count; rollChance = (edge.rollChance ?? 0.3) × cooldown, cooldown = (pass===0 || daysSince>=3) ? 1 : max(0.25, daysSince/3); never roll for town/dungeon/exit targets or a hop already rolled this attempt (rolledHopsRef, cleared on landing); rollEncounter(table for region, predicateStateFromRun, oneShotsFired, deriveRng(`encounter:${mapId}:${from}->${to}`)); oneShot -> markEncounterFired; outcome dialogue -> startDialogue (suspends), battle -> setPendingCaptureTargets(captureTargets ?? []) then onTravelToCombat(nodeId, enemyGroupId) (suspends), checkEvent -> local CheckEventModal (suspends). No encounter -> arriveAtNode, recordEdgeTraversal, emitDomainEvent LocationArrived, consumeHopHead; if final destination is town/camp/dungeon/exit open the quick-action menu.

NodeQuickActionMenu (M&B style) opens on arrival at a destination or when clicking the current node: town -> Enter Town (primary) / Visit Inn / Visit Shop / Visit Tavern (deep-link initialPanel); camp -> Make Camp; dungeon -> Enter Dungeon; exit -> 'Challenge the Iron Throne' (onWin); mid-journey adds Continue Travel and Stay Here (clears path). Digit keys 1-9 choose rows, Esc / outside click dismiss, first enabled row auto-focused; menu flips to the left side when node.x+cameraX+36+220 > STAGE_W-8. An open menu pauses the hop driver, so commitTravel must close it. Clicking during a dialogue or while traveling is ignored.

Hover a node (not traveling) shows a hud-panel tip pinned beside it: '<n> hop(s) · cost <n> food' with food tinted parchment/warn/crit and, when food < hops, 'starvation: <(hops-food)*3> HP/unit'; the hover path's edges light up (roadStyles hover) and the active hop gets an accent stroke + marching comet (.road-comet). Node labels are voice-display, centered in a 160px box, alternate above/below by id hash, use a paper-colored 3px paint-order stroke (never white-on-black), hide when off-screen or when that node's menu is open. Arrival flashes the node name on the band for 1200ms. Caravan token walks the road Bézier (MARKER_WALK_MS 600) and, when settled, sits beside the disc at x-46.

Town = two-page ledger spread on the oak table (page-canvas): left index (INDEX_W 272) with town name, region label, three ghost entries The Inn 'Board & Care' / The Shop 'Goods & Coin' / The Tavern 'Word & Hire' (active = brass margin pin + solid rule + ink weight), Leave Town at the foot; right page scrolls with a top/bottom mask fade and pt-[88px] under the fixed GameHud (showParty=false, surface parchment); panel switch resets scrollTop and plays townEntryIn. Town resolved from worldPosition.nodeId via a 5-entry TOWN_REGISTRY; region label via REGION_DISPLAY. Inn: heals every wounded unit to full for HEAL_COST_PER_UNIT 8g each (button label 'Rest (Ng)' / 'Short Ng' / 'Everyone is healthy'). Shop: shopStockFor(town, items) rarity-gated; rows = kind socket + rarity-inked name + traits line + card count + price column + one Buy/Sell tab (ghost + 'Short Ng' when unaffordable); Your Bag lists every item with Sell. Tavern: quoted rumors, quest board (Talk to <npc> -> startDialogue, first entry primary), empty bounty board, recruitment rows (cost = costOverride ?? recruitmentCost(classId, level); Hire -> addGold(-cost) + recruitUnit(buildUnit(classId, level, name, id)) + setFlag `tavern.recruited.<id>` scope run; hidden once flagged or visibleIf fails).

requirements.text: Camp is a FIELD surface (leather hud-panels on trodden earth): three options — Rest (primary; enabled when food > 0 and party non-empty; dispatches consumeFoodPerHop then restParty {percent:0.2}; footer '<food> food remaining · <n> wounded'), Scout (disabled 'Coming soon'), Leave — plus a Party panel (3-up grid, name + HP numeral + hp-bar) with a 'No one left to muster' empty state. GameHud location='Camp', showParty=false.

Dungeon: if no run.activeDungeon, generateDungeon(deriveRng(run rng,'dungeon:smugglers_cave'), {dungeonId:'smugglers_cave'}) and dispatch enterDungeon; rows render bottom-up (entry row at the bottom), curved SVG passages, 56px round rooms (boss is the only square), reachable = rooms with an edge from the current room; room click -> advanceDungeonRoom then by type: combat/elite/boss -> onCombatRoom(type); rest -> restParty {percent:0.3}; shop -> 2 deterministic offers from items.json (deriveRng `dungeon-shop:${id}`, +10% price for non-common) in a Black-Market Stall dialog with buyItem; treasure -> addGold 50; event -> CheckEventModal from dungeon roomEvents (deriveRng `dungeon-event:${id}`) else addGold 30. Legend chip bottom-right (icon carries hue, word carries meaning), Retreat (danger) top-right at right-16, 'Exit Dungeon' primary when standing on the boss row with clearedRooms >= bossRow -> exitDungeon + onClearAndExit. Dungeon id, name and DUNGEON_DEFS are hardcoded to smugglers_cave although 5 dungeon JSONs exist.

CombatHud root is `pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-[100]`; each interactive child opts in with pointer-events-auto so the board underneath receives tile/unit clicks. Composition: top-center column (TopBar plaque then ModeLabel, flowing — no magic offsets), InitiativeStrip top-3 left-3, PhaseBanner, ForecastPanel, CardHand, CaptureBtn, UnitDetailPanel, Move+EndTurn bottom-4 right-4, DangerZoneToggle bottom-3 left-3. The command zone (hand, Move/End Turn, danger chip) exists only while phase==='COMBAT'; on VICTORY/DEFEAT it plays a COMMAND_EXIT_MS 380 staggered drop-and-fade then unmounts, CaptureBtn is hard-gated, and TopBar swaps to a neutral 'Battle Ended' plate with only the turn count so nothing shouts 'act now' behind the battle-end scrim.

TopBar herald plaque (hud-panel): 'Turn' label chip + numeral | hud-divider | TeamSigil (shield=ally / fangs=enemy, never colour alone) + active unit name in voice-display (enemy in --color-enemy) + 'Your Turn'/'Enemy Turn' small caps | 'Health' HpMeter width 84 + tier-colored numeral current/max | on party turns 'Actions' ApPips current/3. Numbers are the largest text on any combat element.

InitiativeStrip is selector-derived, never stored: useInitiativeQueue = buildInitiativeQueue(alive units) rotated so the active unit is first, memoized on (phase, units, turn.unitId); returns [] outside COMBAT. Shows up to MAX_VISIBLE 8 entries + a '+N' overflow disc; active entry = 54px portrait, scale-110, 2px team ring (hearth for party, enemy red), caret above; others 40px at opacity-75 with a faint ring; each has a team sigil badge and a 10px HP numeral tier-colored. Read-only, always present during COMBAT, independent of selection.

CardHand renders deck.hand.slice(0,5) for the active party unit as <Card>: gem SHAPE by archetype (attack blade / arcane diamond / ward shield / focus eye; type derived from effects: Damage magic->arcane else attack; GrantArmor|Heal->ward; else focus), headline magnitude (Damage base|amount, Heal amount|base, GrantArmor amount) or an effect summary when none ('Draw N', '+N AP', 'Ally +N AP', status words Taunt/Riposte/Empower/Root/Slow/Poison, 'Cleanse', 'Shift N'), footer effect word + target label (one foe / an ally / self / a tile / all foes / all allies), AP coin top-right, L/R gear-source chip top-left, unaffordable = spent hatch + Tooltip 'Needs N AP, you have M' + disabled. Click -> selectCard (ignored while RESOLVING). Drag: pointerdown captures, movement > 14px activates (selects the card, clears pinned detail), an SVG quadratic arrow (#e8a93a, dashed 10 7, ring at cursor) follows; release on a valid tile (in card range AND occupant matches targetKind: enemy/all_enemies need an enemy, ally/all_allies an ally, self = own tile, tile anywhere in range) plays instantly through the same playCard payload; self cards play when released above HAND_TOP_Y 560; anything else cancelSelection.

Targeting is pin-then-play: with a card selected, valid tiles (tilesInRange from the active unit, card.range.min..max) paint attack-red; hovering a valid tile brightens it, draws the AoE preview (aoeRadius) and a floating '-N'/'+N' forecast number plus a 'KO' badge if lethal; first click on a valid tile dispatches pinTarget (opens ForecastPanel, ModeLabel hides while pinned); second click on the same tile, or the panel's Confirm, dispatches playCard {cardId, srcId, targets:[tile], card:{apCost, effects, targetKind, damageStat?, aoeRadius?}} using the COMBAT rng (createRng(state.rng) — a fresh seed once broke replay determinism); clicking an invalid tile cancels selection (silent dead clicks felt broken); Cancel -> unpinTarget keeps the card selected; clicking a unit during targeting targets its tile.

ForecastPanel (hud-panel, absolute top-14 right-4 w-80, role=dialog) appears only when selectedCardId AND pinnedTargetTile resolve to a target unit: header card name + 'LETHAL' chip + 'N AP'; combatant row source portrait -> arrow -> target portrait; HP bar with remaining segment + predicted-loss segment and 'current/max -> after' numerals, Armor bar only when target.armor > 0; math row collapsed to '<total> damage (−a armor, −h HP)' expandable to '<base> base + <stat> STAT − <dr> DR = <total>' (heal shows '+N healed'); status chips with ×stacks; Confirm (primary) / Cancel (ghost). Numbers come from systems/damage.computeForecast(card, source, target, terrainDr=0) — the same function the reducer applies, so shown === applied.

Movement is Fire-Emblem style: while IDLE on a party turn the active unit's reachable tiles (tilesReachable by class startingMov, blocked by living units) are tinted field-blue at MOVE_RANGE_IDLE_ALPHA 0.42 and a click on one moves immediately; the Move button enters SELECTING_MOVE (alpha 0.72, label 'Cancel Move') as a fallback; the active unit can be dragged like a chess piece (press, >10px starts drag, hovered reachable tile brightens to 0.95, drop on a reachable tile moves, otherwise snaps home). One free move per turn (hasMovedThisTurn). Moves capture findMovePath before dispatch and animate tile-by-tile at STEP_MS 120 with click-to-skip; walkingUnits must be marked BEFORE dispatch because the store subscription re-renders synchronously and would snap the sprite to the destination.

End Turn button (primary) enabled when phase COMBAT, party turn, subPhase !== RESOLVING; dispatches endTurn with createRng(state.rng). Both Move and End Turn are !min-w-[140px] leather buttons bottom-right.

Capture buttons (danger variant, stacked bottom-12 left-3 above the danger chip) appear on party turns for every living enemy at manhattan distance 1 from the active unit with hp fraction < 0.5; label 'Capture <name> (<pct>%)' where chance = clamp((1 − hpFrac) × 0.6 + 0.25, 0, 1) (UI estimate of the reducer formula, single attacker); dispatch capture {targetId, attackerIds:[activeId]}; Tooltip explains the roll. Any enemy class is capturable.

Threat reading: hovering any living unit in IDLE previews its move range (ally blue / enemy purple) and a 1-step attack ring; Tab toggles the global danger union (every enemy's reach + 1 step) in DANGER_UNION at alpha 0.72 under any selection overlay. The bottom-left chip shows a Tab keycap + 'Danger zone' + a state pip; because BoardScene owns the toggle, the chip synthesizes a window KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Tab',keyCode:9}) and mirrors state by listening to Tab keydowns — in the rebuild keep this flag in one store.

UnitDetailPanel (hud-panel fixed top-36 right-4 w-[270px]) pins on a plain unit click via combatUiStore.pinnedDetailUnitId (Phaser writes, React reads; not in the reducer, not saved); hidden entirely during SELECTING_TARGET; shows portrait + sigil + name, class + Lv, HP meter + numeral, Armor (if > 0), AP pips, a 2-column grid of str/mag/skl/spd/def/res/lck numerals, status chips with 'Nt', and a Close button.

PhaseBanner: when turn.team flips mid-COMBAT a full-width band ('YOUR TURN' brass / 'ENEMY PHASE' enemy red, voice-display 3xl tracking 0.4em) wipes across at top-1/2 for 1300ms using the phaseBanner keyframe; collapses under reduced motion. ModeLabel shows 'Choose a highlighted tile' (SELECTING_MOVE) / 'Choose a target' (SELECTING_TARGET) with Esc + RMB keycaps 'cancel'.

TutorialOverlay renders only while battleTag==='tutorial' && phase==='COMBAT' and derives its step from state (no step machine): enemy turn -> 'The bandit takes its turn. Watch what it does.'; SELECTING_TARGET -> step 3 'Now click the bandit to strike. The forecast shows the damage before you commit.'; active unit not moved -> step 1 'Every unit gets one free MOVE per turn. Drag Roy like a chess piece — or click a blue tile — to advance toward the bandit.'; else step 2 'Pick a card from your hand below. The amber coin is its ACTION POINT cost — you have 3 AP each turn.'; no enemy alive -> step 4 'The bandit falls. Victory is yours.'. Skip hides it and dispatches markTutorialSeen. Tutorial battle: 5x5 grid, Roy (lord, iron_sword in handLeft) at 0,2 vs 'Bandit' hp 10 str 2 spd 1 at 4,2, authored dirt floor lane along the critical path.

Board render contract: grid sized/centered per battle by boardGeometry (tileSize/gridOriginX/Y) inside the play band between top chrome and the hand; ground = px_grass tiles flipped by a per-cell hash + 47-piece autotiled dirt (seeder floor or generateDirtRegion(rng 'floor')), a shadow slab and brass-edged leather frame; interactive tile rects (TILE−2) with checker variance on TILE_BASE; units = ally disc r16 / enemy 4-point star (9/17) with 2.5 rim, or a baked board sprite (÷8 box-filtered, LINEAR filter) over a team-colored base ellipse; transparent r22 hit circle; HP bar 36×6 well + 32×4 fill tier-colored (ok/warn/crit) at +20; name label (Cinzel 11px, stroked) only for the ACTIVE unit; depth = container.y (painter's order); active unit brass ring r23, pinned target ember ring; dead units hidden. Overlay paint order: hover preview < Tab danger union < idle move range < SELECTING_MOVE range < card-target tiles (hot when hovered/pinned). Effects: PlayTween walks a path or yoyo-lunges (duration/2), HitFlash (sprite alpha 0.4 or white fill), FloatDamage (+/−N monospace 20px, rises 40px over 600ms, plays sfx), ShakeCamera, WaitForAnimations; animationsCompleted dispatched when pendingAnimations hits 0 in RESOLVING.

Enemy turns run from the render layer: when phase COMBAT, subPhase IDLE, team enemy and turn.unitId set, planTurn(state, rng, unitId) fills a queue; first dispatch after 500ms; moveUnit events mark walkingUnits then schedule the next after 150ms; animation-producing events wait for maybeAnimationsComplete (+300ms); endTurn drains and immediately re-plans if the next unit is also an enemy (otherwise the loop stalls because the subscription fired while enemyTurnRunning was true). The rebuild should drive this from a non-render game-flow controller that awaits animation promises.

Dialog wrapper: RAC ModalOverlay `fixed inset-0 z-[800]` portaled into the stage; position 'center' (surface-iron panel, min-w-[400px] max-w-[80vw], rounded-md, p-6 unless unpadded, scale-95/translate-y-3 enter) or 'bottom' (full-width band, bg-stone-950/95, rises from translate-y-5); backdrop 'heavy' bg-black/70 or 'veil' bg-black/55 + blur 2px (pause/save/load); isDismissable default true (Esc + backdrop). Tooltip wrapper = hud-panel body-xs with an ink/brass arrow, delay 500ms, portaled likewise; Focusable is re-exported for wrapping disabled triggers. Raw react-aria(-components) imports outside ui/components are lint-banned.

PauseMenu (Dialog veil, w-[392px], page-canvas ledger sheet): 'Paused' / 'the world holds its breath'; Resume = primary leather (autoFocus); ruled ghost lines Save Game (disabled outside a run with 'nothing to save outside a campaign'), Load Game; heavier rule; Return to Title (inline confirm 'Return to Title?' / 'Unsaved progress will be lost — the march ends here.' with danger button + Cancel), Quit; footer Sound toggle (speaker glyph + ap-pip + ON/OFF numeral) dispatching metaStore setAudioMuted. Lines get a brass margin tick on hover/focus; entrance is a staggered Rise (0/30/60/90/120/150ms).

Save/Load modals (Dialog veil, w-[476px], page-canvas): three slots (NUM_SLOTS 3, localStorage keys fe-mb:save:slot:N + sidecar fe-mb:save:meta) rendered as ledger lines — inked folio number, formatLocationName(summary.location) in voice-display, party/gold/food glyph numerals, formatSaveDate at right; empty slot = outlined folio + 'blank page'. Save: choosing a written slot shows an inline confirm row 'Overwrite this chronicle?' with a danger Overwrite + Cancel (other rows dim to 0.4); subtitle 'three folios — choose the line to write on'. Load: empty slots disabled; all-empty shows the empty state whose copy must keep the phrase 'No saved games' (e2e boot contract) — 'No saved games yet — the chronicle is unwritten.' / 'Save from the pause menu, out on the road.'.

QuestLog (Dialog, w-[540px], toggled by Q): lists runStore.questStates; 'N contract(s) standing' subtitle; each entry = brass seal pin (open) or inked ring + check (settled), name from a local QUEST_DESCRIPTIONS table then the quest registry ('Unmarked entry' last resort), stage prose from the table ('The trail is cold.' fallback), settled entries strikethrough + 'Settled' chip; empty state 'No work on the books.' / 'Taverns post jobs on the notice board — ask around.'. PartyLoadoutModal (Dialog, w-[860px], toggled by I): left column = muster tabs (portrait + name; active tab has an inset brass edge), In hand = Left/Right slot wells (rarity edge + gem, item name in rarity ink, '+N cards' numeral, kind · 2H, Unequip ghost; right slot shows 'Locked — two-handed weapon' when left is 2H; empty = sword watermark 'empty'), Deck next battle preview grouped by source (Class / Left hand / Right hand) built with buildDeckForUnit; right column = bag manifest stacked by definition id with ×N tally, kind line, Equip L (primary only on the line under the pointer/keyboard) + Equip R; disabled equips stay fully opaque, struck through, with a Tooltip carrying planEquip's reason translated to fiction (two-handed / 'Both hands grip the two-handed weapon.' / bag full / etc.); footer '+N consumable(s) (food, potions)'. All mutations via equipItem/unequipItem dispatch.

DialogueModal is driven entirely by runStore.pendingDialogue {dialogueId, nodeId}: non-dismissable bottom band (page-canvas strip with ruling and weave) over a 55% dim; two persistent bust slots — a speaker claims left then right on first line and keeps it, a third speaker replaces the non-speaking slot, the speaking bust is lit/forward and the listener is brightness 0.68 + translateY 6px + scale 0.95, busts are full-body sprites (height 300, right side mirrored) or a 120px portrait fallback; narrator lines show a centered NARRATOR sigil banner and italic dim prose; name plate = surface-parchment tag with a 2px --id-* identity underline, anchored inboard of the bust column (left-52 / right-52). Text reveals at 36 cps (useTypewriter; reduced motion = instant); clicking the text skips the reveal or advances the single unconditional Continue choice; branching choices render only after reveal as ruled ghost entries (.dlg-choice) that take a leather strap on hover/focus, disabled choices stay legible (muted italic, dead chevron); gated choices use CheckButton, stat checks open CheckCandidatePicker then advance with attemptingUnitId. Node onEnter effects dispatch applyQuestEffects once per (dialogueId,nodeId); step() effects dispatch likewise; nextNodeId 'end' -> endDialogue else startDialogue next. Missing tree/node render an error dialog with Close.

[STR 7]' listing living party with stat value and check/cross, failing candidates still selectable); after resolution narration replaces the description and Continue calls onResolve -> caller dispatches applyQuestEffects(outcome.effects). The road goes on.' / 'Your party has fallen. The road claims another company.' / 'The Warlord is defeated. The frontier is crossed.'); ordinary victory shows the enemies-defeated numeral as the largest text, Survivors chips (ally diamond) and Fallen chips (strikethrough, 'Lost for good. The company marches lighter.'); run-ended states show daysElapsed 'Days on the Road' and a dotted-leader ledger of runStats (Hops traveled, Battles won, Enemies defeated, Enemies captured, Companions lost, Gold earned, Gear found; zero -> '—'); buttons Continue (primary) / Restart / Return to Title, or New Run (primary) / Return to Title. requirements.text: GameHud (non-combat screens): fixed top-center context/resource plate — region small-caps + location voice-display | Day numeral | Food numeral (parchment when >4, hp-warn 1-4, hp-crit + 800ms pulse at 0; scale-pops when a hop consumes one) | Gold numeral in --color-hearth via var() (Tailwind's text-hearth bakes the root value and ignores the page scope) — and an optional party roster card (portrait clipped circle(50%), name, tier numeral, hp-bar; dead units 40% grayscale) plus an objective line for the first incomplete quest. surface='parchment' turns both into .surface-parchment page cards (band-safe inset shadow); 'dark' uses hud-panel. showParty and partyClassName control the roster.

Ground scopes are the whole trick: `.page-canvas` (a screen) and `.surface-parchment` (a card) re-declare --color-parchment #2a2119, --color-parchment-dim #57493a, --color-text-muted #5e5040, --color-hearth/--color-hearth-soft #6e4705, --color-damage-text/--hp-crit-text #9a2c22, --hp-warn #6e4705, --hp-ok #445b24 and set color: var(--color-ink); `.surface-iron, .hud-panel, .btn-forged:not(.btn-forged--ghost), .forged-card` re-assert the bone ramp (#f1e9d8 / #d5c8ad / #b3a68e / #d9a93f / #c99a33 / #e8806c / #e8806c / #d9a93f / #7ba33f). Components read tokens by ROLE (--color-parchment = primary text on THIS ground) so they invert automatically by specificity; ghost buttons deliberately take the ground's ramp.

Type voices: --font-display "Cinzel" (Trajan Pro, Georgia, serif) for names/titles/places (lowercase renders as small caps), --font-body "EB Garamond" (Georgia, Times New Roman, serif) for prose/dialogue/labels, --font-numeric ui-monospace/SFMono-Regular/Cascadia Mono/Consolas for raw numbers only; utilities .voice-display (letter-spacing 0.04em) and .numeral (tabular-nums, 0.01em). Fonts are self-hosted variable woff2 in public/fonts (fonts.css) and preloaded from index.html — no CDN.

Material recipes to port verbatim: .surface-iron (158deg iron-700 42% over iron-900, --bevel-iron, 40% brass border), .surface-parchment (180deg canvas-base->mid 72%->deep, 1px dashed --canvas-rule, --elevation-flat + inner 1px #fffcf4/0.5), .hud-panel (four --rivet-* radial layers + 158deg rgba(74,52,33,0.96)->rgba(28,20,13,0.97), 1px rgba(28,18,9,0.9) border, radius-md, --bevel-iron + inset 5px rgba(176,138,62,0.3) tooled line, backdrop-blur 3px), .hud-panel-header (1px dashed rgba(176,138,62,0.38) bottom), .hud-divider (1px rgba(176,138,62,0.3); page scope -> --canvas-rule), .ap-pip 9px brass disc (--full gradient #e6c887->iron-edge->#7a5a1e, --empty rgba(0,0,0,0.4)), .hp-bar 6px pill + .hp-bar__fill (width transition --dur-move), .iron-grain (SVG fractalNoise 0.85/3 octaves, 180px, overlay, 0.09), .hearth-glow(-strong) = top-down daylight wash only, .btn-forged base + --primary (brass edge, #fbf3e2 text) / --danger (oxblood) / --ghost (transparent, etched on hover) with data-hovered/pressed/focus-visible/disabled states, .btn-prose opt-out, .forged-card (bevel, hover inset brass 0.55, selected inset 2px iron-edge, disabled saturate .4 brightness .72).

Binding rules: no new hex values in components (add tokens to index.css); canvas colours only in the boardPalette mirror; never bypass Button/Dialog/Tooltip/Menu/ListBox wrappers with raw elements; texture on chrome only, never on numeric data; numbers are the largest text on any combat element; every small-text pair clears AA 4.5:1 against its OWN ground and, on a page, against both --canvas-base and --canvas-mid (keep small muted text out of the bottom ~15% deep band, audited 4.16:1); colour is never the only channel (shield/fangs sigils, gem shapes, disc vs star, brass pin + rule weight for selection); ONE primary (leather) per page; NOTHING glows — no radial pools, flicker, vignettes, emissive rims, glow-on-hover (hearthFlicker is retained inert); light falls, never emits; every loop collapses under prefers-reduced-motion (the :root --dur-* override plus explicit animation:none on named loops and [style*="..."] inline ones).

Board overlay grammar (one hue never means two things): field-blue = my movement range (MOVE_RANGE 0x24455f; idle 0.42 / mode 0.72 / drag 0.95), attack-red = valid card targets & enemy strike reach (CARD_TARGET_FILL 0x5e1a13 / edge 0xb8402c; 0.52, hot 0.85), red-purple = enemy danger union (0x3c1c36 @0.72; hover-enemy-move 0x4c2846), arcane = AoE preview (0x8f74d2, fill 0.25 edge 0.8), brass = the active unit ring (0xd9a93f), ember = pinned target ring (0xb8402c); units ally 0x6f93bd rim 0x16293a, enemy 0xc0644e rim 0x3a170f; HP tier fills ok 0x7ba33f / warn 0xd9a93f / crit 0xa6432f; text name #f1e9d8, outline #000, heal #8fd45f, damage #ff7a5c, magic #8fb4e8, KO #f1e9d8 on #6e1d16.

Identity ramp (--id-gold/steel/rose/moss/arcane/ember/slate/wine, each a color-mix of an existing token toward the ground's text colour) is used ONLY for who someone is: portrait rings/fills (color-mix accent 26% into ink; ring 55%) and the 2px name-plate underline. ui/data/characters.ts maps speaker name -> {displayName, initials, sprite?, accent, faction party|enemy|neutral|narrator|noble|mystic, shape circle|square|hex|diamond|triangle}; unknown speakers hash into the same ramp; enemy-team combat units without a registry entry are forced to --color-enemy. CharacterPortrait resolves art by unitId/classId via data/unitSprites (never by display name), crops the top ~45% (objectPosition 50% 12%, scale 1.9), and falls back to initials.

Rarity is a NAME colour + a quiet edge, never a saturated border: RARITY_TEXT/RARITY_EDGE mix gem-ward 55% (uncommon), ally 65% (rare), gem-arcane 60% (epic), gem-focus 72% (legendary) toward --color-parchment; on a linen page legendary must drop to 45% (72% measured 3.30:1 base / 2.94:1 mid); the loadout also draws a per-rarity gem SHAPE (circle/square/diamond/triangle/star) so rank survives colour-blindness. Legendary never uses --color-hearth (reserved for 'act here').

Icons are one inline-SVG component (24 viewBox, stroke 1.8, round caps/joins, currentColor; aria-hidden unless aria-label given) with names town/camp/dungeon/exit/combat/elite/boss/rest/shop/event/treasure/visited/quest/narrator/chevron-right/chevron-down/arrow-right/pause/skull/check/cross/shield/fangs/bolt; NO emoji or pictograph unicode in player-visible JSX; physical keys render as Keycap chips (Tab/Esc/RMB), never '[Tab]'. Screen-local glyph sets (town item kinds, save-slot party/gold/food, speaker, sword) follow the same grammar and should fold into the one set.

Ledger page furniture pattern (currently copy-pasted 6×): a Sheet = 168deg gradient #f3ecda -> canvas-base 42% -> canvas-mid (never canvas-deep), iron-grain multiply 0.4, feint ruling every 30px at rgba(42,33,25,0.09), double margin rule at gutter 26/30 (0.34/0.16), four 8px brass pins (radial #f0d79a -> iron-edge 52% -> #6d5218, shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(46,32,16,0.5)); PageHead = uppercase voice-display title tracking 0.26em + italic body subtitle + ghost close, then rules of weight 0.46 and 0.22 separated by 3px; content column pl-[42px] pr-6; 'Rule' = 1px rgba(42,33,25,weight). Build ONE <LedgerPage> kit and use it for pause/save/load/quest/loadout/battle-end/town/title.
